description:
## [1.33.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.33.0) (2026-10-27)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** restored video playback and downloads. MovieBox added a new X-Client-Build header requirement on Oct 27 — without it the server refuses streams and downloads, showing "No stream for this title". Added BuildTagInterceptor that computes the required tag from the stock signing certificate + salt + timestamp + MD5. Same fix as hxreborn v1.65.0-dev.3. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK.**
